info.title: Pathology Network API
info.description: Pathology Network Platform API v1. Errors use { error: { code, message, status, details } }; lists use { data, pagination: { next_cursor, limit } }.

post.summary: POST /abha-verifications: OTP to the ABHA's mobile
POST /abha-verifications/{txnId}/confirmation
POST /abha-qr-scans
POST /abha-enrolments: Aadhaar OTP, after recording consent
POST /abha-enrolments/{txnId}/confirmation
POST /abha-enrolments/{txnId}/address
POST /abha-profile-shares/{share}/link

get.summary:
GET /agent/orders?since=: tests waiting for results at the agent's lab,
changed since the given time, with the parameter codes analysers report

post.summary: POST /agent/results: always 200 with what was accepted, unchanged (replays) and rejected

summarised_through.description: Dashboards show the summary up to last night, never live figures.
Dashboards show the summary up to last night, never live figures.

post.summary: The key is in this response only; store it in the agent's configuration
POST /payment-links: a gateway link for the balance, sent to the patient
POST /payments/{payment}/refunds. The payment is reached through a visible invoice
Scan-driven: one call per scan or per batch of scans
POST /orders: retry-safe with an Idempotency-Key (spec §8.5)
Add-on tests: answers with the supplementary invoice

get.summary: GET /patients?q=… : search is required, the patient list is never browsable
A merged record answers with the record that survived (spec §7.3)

post.summary: 202 whether or not the phone is registered: the answer reveals nothing

get.summary: GET /report-links/{report}?expires&signature: the PDF behind a link sent to the patient or doctor
GET /me/reports: the lab reports from our network, newest first
GET /me/records: every current record, newest first
GET /me/records/{id}/file?version=: the lab's PDF, or the uploaded file (newest version by default)

post.summary: POST /me/records/{id}/documents: a new version of an uploaded file

get.summary: A region with its direct children, so clients can walk the tree

post.summary: Releases a signed report, or withholds it for a client with overdue dues (status `withheld`)
Starts the next version; answers with it

POST /results: values for one test. Changing results that are already
stored needs If-Match with the test's ETag, so two people never
overwrite each other (spec §8.7). 201 when results were first created
POST /order-items/{id}/verify: every result of the test's current run

get.summary: GET /samples/{barcode}: scanners look samples up by barcode; the ID works too

post.summary:
POST /orders/{id}/samples: barcodes and ZPL labels for every container
the order needs. 201 when new containers were planned, 200 when the
order already had them all
Accession at the lab for a sample drawn there
Rejects the sample and answers with the redraw now awaiting collection

get.summary: The PDF; 202 while it is still being rendered

delete.summary: Revokes at once: every link and doctor view stops working

get.summary:
GET /me/trends: every parameter ever reported, with its latest value.
A patient has at most a few hundred, so this is one page

Open tests by default (pending and entered); `filter[status]` picks one
status, including verified and withdrawn. Oldest due first

GET /order-items/{id}/results: the test at the caller's lab with its
current results, plus earlier runs. The ETag goes back in If-Match

AbhaStatus.description: ABHA link state on a patient (spec §5.7).
AbhaStatus.title: AbhaStatus

AddOrderItemsRequest.description: POST /orders/{id}/items: add-on tests with their own invoice.
AddOrderItemsRequest.title: AddOrderItemsRequest

AgentResultsRequest.description:
An upload from the interface agent: values read by analysers, with the
analyser's own timestamps (spec §11: replayed after an outage, in order).
AgentResultsRequest.title: AgentResultsRequest

AgreementRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a draft agreement.
AgreementRequest.title: AgreementRequest

AssignBarcodeRequest.description: A pre-printed label stuck on the tube (Code 128, letters, digits and hyphens).
AssignBarcodeRequest.title: AssignBarcodeRequest

B2bClientRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a B2B client. The code is set once.
B2bClientRequest.title: B2bClientRequest

BillingModel.description:
How a franchise pays HQ (spec glossary). | | |---| | `revenue_share`
Franchise earns commission_pct of what it bills; HQ keeps the rest. | | `wholesale`
Franchise buys each test at partner price from a prepaid wallet. |
BillingModel.title: BillingModel

BranchRequest.description:
Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a branch. Code and ownership
are set once at creation.
BranchRequest.title: BranchRequest

CapabilitiesRequest.description: The complete set of tests a lab can run (PUT replaces all).
CapabilitiesRequest.title: CapabilitiesRequest

CollectSampleRequest.description: Recording a draw; offline apps send the real collection time later.
CollectSampleRequest.title: CollectSampleRequest

ConsentStatus.description: Consent lifecycle (spec §7.11); mirrors ABDM consent artefacts.
ConsentStatus.title: ConsentStatus

CreateInterfaceAgentRequest.description: A lab's interface agent and the addresses (or CIDR ranges) it may call from.
CreateInterfaceAgentRequest.title: CreateInterfaceAgentRequest

CreateManifestRequest.description: A new bag; staff at one branch may leave out the sending branch.
CreateManifestRequest.title: CreateManifestRequest

DispatchManifestRequest.description: Courier and temperature check at dispatch (spec §7.6).
DispatchManifestRequest.title: DispatchManifestRequest

DispatchStockRequest.description: The sender may set the charge as it ships.
DispatchStockRequest.title: DispatchStockRequest

EnterResultsRequest.description:
Results for one test: a value per parameter code. Values are text as
reported; JSON numbers are accepted and read as text.
EnterResultsRequest.title: EnterResultsRequest

FamilyMemberRequest.description: A dependant without a UHID yet (POST), or changes to a member (PATCH).
FamilyMemberRequest.title: FamilyMemberRequest

FamilyRelation.description: How a family member relates to the account holder.
FamilyRelation.title: FamilyRelation

FranchiseDocumentStatus.description:
| | |---| | `uploaded`
| | `auto_verified`
The KYC vendor's check passed; a person still verifies it. | | `verified`
| | `rejected`
|
FranchiseDocumentStatus.title: FranchiseDocumentStatus

FranchiseModel.description: What the franchise runs: collection only, or its own lab too (spec §5.1 step 3).
FranchiseModel.title: FranchiseModel

FranchiseRequest.description:
Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a franchise. The code is set
once; status and balance never change here.
FranchiseRequest.title: FranchiseRequest

HealthProfileRequest.description: The whole health profile (PUT): fields left out are cleared.
HealthProfileRequest.title: HealthProfileRequest

HomeCollectionStatusRequest.description: Status updates from the phlebotomist app, with GPS on collection (spec §5.3).
HomeCollectionStatusRequest.title: HomeCollectionStatusRequest

InventoryItemRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a stock batch. Branch, code and batch are set once.
InventoryItemRequest.title: InventoryItemRequest

InvoicePaymentStatus.description: credit: billed to a B2B client on credit terms.
InvoicePaymentStatus.title: InvoicePaymentStatus

LabTestRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a test. The code is fixed at creation.
LabTestRequest.title: LabTestRequest

LedgerAdjustmentRequest.description: A manual ledger correction: one partner, one side, a reason from the lookup list (spec §6).
LedgerAdjustmentRequest.title: LedgerAdjustmentRequest

LedgerEntryType.description: What a partner ledger row records (spec §5.6, §7.8).
LedgerEntryType.title: LedgerEntryType

ManifestItemCondition.description: sample_transfer_items.condition: how a sample arrived at the receiving lab.
ManifestItemCondition.title: ManifestItemCondition

ManifestSamplesRequest.description: Barcodes scanned into an open bag.
ManifestSamplesRequest.title: ManifestSamplesRequest

MarkSettledRequest.description: The bank transfer that settled the statement (UTR); not needed when nothing is payable.
MarkSettledRequest.title: MarkSettledRequest

OtpChallengeRequest.description: Ask for a sign-in code by SMS: a patient or a referring doctor.
OtpChallengeRequest.title: OtpChallengeRequest

PatientRequest.description:
Register (POST) or correct (PATCH) a patient. Registration records the
consent notice shown (spec §10 DPDP); either a date of birth or an age is
required.
PatientRequest.title: PatientRequest

PriceListItemsRequest.description: The complete set of prices for a list (PUT replaces all items).
PriceListItemsRequest.title: PriceListItemsRequest

PriceListRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH). The list type is fixed at creation.
PriceListRequest.title: PriceListRequest

PriceListType.description: mrp: what patients pay. partner: what HQ charges a franchise. client: what HQ charges a B2B client (spec §7.4).
PriceListType.title: PriceListType

ReceiveManifestRequest.description: Barcodes scanned at the receiving lab, each accepted or rejected with a reason.
ReceiveManifestRequest.title: ReceiveManifestRequest

RecordFileRequest.description: A new version of an uploaded record's file (multipart).
RecordFileRequest.title: RecordFileRequest

RecordSource.description: Where a health-locker record came from (spec §7.11).
RecordSource.title: RecordSource

RegionRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a region.
RegionRequest.title: RegionRequest

RejectSampleRequest.description: A reason from the configured list, plus a free-text note (spec §6 reasons rule).
RejectSampleRequest.title: RejectSampleRequest

ReportDelivery.description: How a referring doctor receives reports (spec §7.3).
ReportDelivery.title: ReportDelivery

RerouteSampleRequest.description: Send a sample to another lab; without a lab, the routing rules choose.
RerouteSampleRequest.title: RerouteSampleRequest

ResultFlag.description: Where a result sits against its reference range (spec §5.5 step 1).
ResultFlag.title: ResultFlag

ResultSource.description: Where a result came from. `calculated` is an addition to the spec's analyser/manual: derived parameters such as LDL are computed here.
ResultSource.title: ResultSource

RoleRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a custom role. Scope level is fixed at creation.
RoleRequest.title: RoleRequest

RoutingRuleRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH). The source branch is fixed at creation.
RoutingRuleRequest.title: RoutingRuleRequest

ScopeLevel.description: How much of the network a role can see (spec §4, roles.scope_level).
ScopeLevel.title: ScopeLevel

SettlementStatus.description: Settlement lifecycle (spec §5.6): draft → pending_approval → approved → settled; side exit disputed → approved.
SettlementStatus.title: SettlementStatus

ShareRecordsRequest.description: Share records with a registered doctor (by phone), an email address or a link.
ShareRecordsRequest.title: ShareRecordsRequest

links.description: Shown once, when a link share is made: only hashes are stored.

ShareTarget.description: Who a record is shared with (spec §7.11 record_shares.shared_with_type).
ShareTarget.title: ShareTarget

SignReportRequest.description:
The authenticator code (spec §10.4: signing re-asks it) and, optionally,
the departments to sign; without them every department the signer may
sign now is signed.
SignReportRequest.title: SignReportRequest

SigningDiscipline.description: Which qualification may sign a department's results (spec §7.2, §10).
SigningDiscipline.title: SigningDiscipline

StockTransferRequest.description: Request (POST) a transfer, or change quantity / charge while it is still requested (PATCH).
StockTransferRequest.title: StockTransferRequest

StockTransferStatus.description: Kit and consumable supply between branches (spec §7.7).
StockTransferStatus.title: StockTransferStatus

StoreSignatoryRequest.description: A new signatory with their signature image (multipart, PNG).
StoreSignatoryRequest.title: StoreSignatoryRequest

TestParameterRequest.description:
A parameter and, optionally, its full set of reference ranges. Option
parameters need their options; calculated ones need a formula.
TestParameterRequest.title: TestParameterRequest

UpdateSignatoryRequest.description: Registration details and validity; who, where and which department never change.
UpdateSignatoryRequest.title: UpdateSignatoryRequest

UploadFranchiseDocumentRequest.description: A KYC paper (multipart): PDF or a photo, at most 5 MB.
UploadFranchiseDocumentRequest.title: UploadFranchiseDocumentRequest

UploadRecordRequest.description: A record the patient adds (multipart): what it is, when it is from, and the file.
UploadRecordRequest.title: UploadRecordRequest

UserRequest.description: Create (POST) and partial update (PATCH) of a staff member.
UserRequest.title: UserRequest

WalletTopupRequest.description: A wallet top-up. Franchise users top up their own wallet; HQ names the franchise.
WalletTopupRequest.title: WalletTopupRequest

WalletTopupStatus.description:
| | |---| | `pending`
Payment link sent; waiting for the gateway webhook. | | `paid`
|
WalletTopupStatus.title: WalletTopupStatus

WorklistStatus.description: One test waiting at the lab that runs it: results pending, all entered, all verified, or withdrawn because its sample was re-routed or rejected.
WorklistStatus.title: WorklistStatus

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
